setup: CREATE TABLE g06_1f_2b_g07_3b AS SELECT i, CASE i % 4 WHEN 0 THEN 'alpha' WHEN 1 THEN 'beta' WHEN 2 THEN 'gamma' ELSE 'delta' END AS v, CASE i % 2 WHEN 0 THEN '{}:{}' ELSE '{1}:{0}' END AS fmt, CASE i % 4 WHEN 0 THEN '^([0-9]+)-alpha$' WHEN 1 THEN '^([0-9]+)-beta$' WHEN 2 THEN '^([0-9]+)-gamma$' ELSE '^([0-9]+)-delta$' END AS pattern, CASE i % 4 WHEN 0 THEN 'a+b' WHEN 1 THEN 'c?d' WHEN 2 THEN '[xy]' ELSE 'plain' END AS escaped FROM range(50000) t(i); CREATE TABLE g07_3b_from_first AS SELECT i FROM range(50000) t(i)

workloads.name: g07_3b_from_first_filtered_aggregation_50k
workloads.sql: SELECT sum(i) FROM (FROM g07_3b_from_first WHERE i % 2 = 0) filtered
